title.en: Make a Short Flash and a Long Pause

brief.zh: 巡查车要用短闪报到。让 L 每次亮 250 毫秒，再灭 1000 毫秒。调整两段等待，运行后检查一整轮。
brief.en: The patrol cart checks in with a short flash. Light L for 250 ms and leave it off for 1000 ms. Adjust the two waits and check a complete cycle.

concept.zh: 分别控制亮灯与熄灯时间
concept.en: Set independent on and off times
